rows.en: Garyud: "Ciel has left... Good."
Zigrim Soldier: "That's..."
Zigrim Soldier: "M-Major Grad...
That's the Sword Radiance, Phantom Saint's mech..."
Grad: "Bosendorfer... So it's finally come out.
But... What an intimidating presence."
Garyud: "...Oh? So Zigrim still has someone
with this much Prana."
Grad: "...Garyud Via Vratzen,
I presume?"
Garyud: "Indeed."
Grad: "I'm with the Zigrim Republic Army's Second Division,
Alma Front Army. My name is Grad Burgley."
Garyud: "That name... It's been a long time since I heard it."
Grad: "Circumstances kept me away from the front
for a time. And now my first opponent on returning
is you, Lord Vratzen. I'm not a lucky man..."
Garyud: "Heh... The feared 'Lion of the West'...
You are certainly a worthy opponent.
Even for my final curtain."
Grad: "Lord Vratzen... Surely you don't..."
Garyud: "Well, shall we begin?"
Miyasco: "Belnea Fort will enter radar range shortly."
Celica: "Put it on the monitor."
Miyasco: "Understood."
Derock: "That's quite a force."
Reduce: "...Thank goodness.
The escape route's still clear..."
Celica: "An escape route?"
Reduce: "Yes. Belnea Fort has an escape route
prepared for emergencies. If all goes well,
we can act as a decoy while they escape through it."
Oswald: "But wouldn't even we be in danger
if these troops, apparently waiting in the rear
rather than on the front line, were committed?"
Cain: "True. But why would they make the foolish mistake
of splitting their forces like this? Zigrim's commander
must be either an utter idiot or a schemer."
Reduce: "According to the information His Majesty King Fram gave me,
their commander appears to be Grad Burgley himself."
Cain: "...It bothers me that he gave away information
for nothing, but the information itself is very credible.
That would make it the latter...
This may not be so simple."
Reduce: "That's why I'll try to negotiate first.
If negotiations break down, please deploy the Spirit Mechs
and rescue Lord Garyud and Ciel."
Arthur: "That's far too dangerous."
Reduce: "We cannot simply launch an attack.
And we must avoid making the Spirit Mechs
enemies of a particular nation. This is the best way to..."
Alforina: "I cannot allow that.
To lose you as well as Tyron..."
Ai: "Oh!"
Oswald: "Y-Your Majesty!"
Ymir: "Are you well enough to be up already?"
Alforina: "Yes. I'm still a little dizzy, but..."
Ai: "Honestly! I told you over and over to stay in bed!"
Alforina: "I'm sorry.
But I'm all right now.
Instead, couldn't we use Liebhofen itself as a deterrent,
have them escape in the meantime, pick them up
and withdraw?
A show of force is nothing to be proud of,
but let us regard it as unavoidable
if it spares us needless fighting."
Clovis: "Well, that would probably be less dangerous.
I don't like negotiating from somewhere safe either, though."
Reduce: "..."
Alforina: "I understand how you feel as a warrior,
but could you please restrain yourself this time?"
Reduce: "...No, you are too kind...
As you wish. Then, as for the details of the operation..."
Alforina: "...Ah..."
Ai: "Alforina!"
Reduce: "Your Majesty!"
Alforina: "...I'm all right. I just felt a little dizzy."
Ai: "You're not that strong to begin with,
so don't overdo it! Come on, back to the infirmary..."
Oswald: "Then allow me to carry her.
You have the operation briefing to attend, after all..."
Ai: "W-Well, yes, but..."
Miyasco: "I'll go with you, then.
Derock, please take over."
Derock: "Roger. You can count on me."
Cain: "..."
Oswald: "...Then let us go..."
Arthur: "You needn't worry. She'll be all right."
Ai: "Yeah..."
Garyud: "What are you thinking?
Are you seriously challenging me to a duel?"
Grad: "I, too, am a knight of sorts.
I wish to cross swords with the Sword Radiance, Phantom Saint...
Is that so strange?
Besides, it seems we both harbor the same thoughts."
Garyud: "You..."
Grad: "It seems we both insist
on living the hard way."
Garyud: "Heh... Grad Burgley.
You are the man the rumors say you are. Very well.
I accept your challenge.
But I will not hold back. You will face my full strength."
Grad: "Yes. I wouldn't have it any other way..."
Derock: "I've confirmed it.
York's Armored Mech is Bosendorfer."
Fain: "Oooh! It's just as magnificent as ever! What a beauty!
Someday, I want a mech like that..."
Reduce: "Is that... Could it be a duel?"
Touya: "You mean the kind where they fight one on one?"
Reduce: "Yes. Those stances follow ancient custom,
so it appears to be a formal duel."
Touya: "Is there a difference?"
Reduce: "It isn't merely a matter of showing off one's strength
or building a reputation. The two armies' representatives fight,
and their result determines the outcome of the battle itself."
Touya: "Then while they're busy..."
Reduce: "No. Neither army may interfere in any way
during the duel. If anyone breaks that rule,
they are deemed to have defiled the sacred duel
and must be punished by both armies."
Touya: "Then we can't do anything but watch?"
Reduce: "That's right. Even though
we are a third party."
Fain: "Oooh! That really is Lord Grad Burgley's
mech. I'd heard he'd retired...
To see it with my own eyes! I'm thrilled!"
Touya: "I don't really get it,
but he's that incredible, huh?"
Reduce: "The Sword Radiance holders, including Lord Garyud...
Those two aside, one of the Three Strongest Knights of the Continent
is Grad Burgley."
Touya: "Huh. But 'Sword Radiance,'
the 'Three Strongest,' your Three Sword Knights...
This world's old-fashioned in the weirdest ways."
Clovis: "It sure is. Though its technology is way beyond
our world's. But why agree to a duel
when you have such an overwhelming advantage?"
Reduce: "I was wondering that myself.
Even Grad must know Lord Garyud's strength.
And yet he agreed to the duel..."
Touya: "Anyway, we can't interfere right now, can we?
Then all we can do is watch."
Grad: "This is a duel between two warriors.
Its outcome will decide the result for both armies. Agreed?"
Garyud: "...I understand fully."
Grad: "Then... Here I come!"
Grad: (Forgive me, Thora... Kururu...)
Grad: "...You are as strong as I expected."
Garyud: "As are you."
Grad: "...I'd forgotten this feeling for so long."
Garyud: "We are both warriors, after all."
Grad: "Heh heh..."
Garyud: "?!"
Zigrim Soldier: "Heh heh heh... Too late..."
Grad: "What?!"
Zigrim Soldier: "...Die."
Ciel: "..."
Zigrim Soldier: "What?!"
Zigrim Soldier: "Uooooooh!!"
Grad: "A sniper...?! Has our army become
this corrupt?! What meaning is there in winning
if we stoop to this...? Ghh..."
Garyud: "Ciel! Why...?"
Ciel: "You're as bad an actor as Tyron, Father."
Garyud: "I thought you were being unusually obedient...
Surely the others haven't...?"
Ciel: "Don't worry. I've already sent everyone else on their way.
We're the only two left in this fort."
Grad: "Lord Vratzen, I am deeply sorry.
With things as they are..."
Garyud: "Grad... I know this wasn't
your doing. Once more..."
Zigrim Soldier: "Major Grad!"
Grad: "Quiet! This is not interference.
We are the ones who defiled the duel.
Do not interfere..."
Zigrim Soldier: "York's Armored Mech has interfered
in the duel!"
Zigrim Soldier: "Protect the major!"
Zigrim Soldier: "A-Aaaaaaah!"
Grad: "They're stirring them up? His Excellency's... No, surely not..."
Touya: "Hey, this is getting out of hand..."
Cain: "What will you do?
If we just stand by and watch, those two
are certain to die."
Reduce: "I'm sorry, but I'm going out there.
Please take Liebhofen out of here."
Ymir: "Please wait!
Surely it's worth trying to negotiate..."
Cain: "I wouldn't do that.
Look. The Zigrim soldiers' movements are completely disorganized.
That's proof their commander's orders aren't reaching them anymore.
Why don't we descend all at once to throw them into confusion,
pick up the two mechs,
then withdraw at full speed?"
Celica: "I agree with Cain.
We can't abandon those two."
Fain: "Let's go!"
Ymir: "...You're right. Running away would be easy,
but if we can't save two people,
how can we save the world? ...Let's go!"
Celica: "All riiight!
Once we disengage optical cloaking, deploy the Spirit Mechs!"
Miyasco: "How are you feeling?"
Alforina: "Much better, thank you."
Oswald: "..."
Alforina: "Hmm? Is something wrong?
You look rather pale."
Oswald: "...Y-Yes. Forgive me.
I'm feeling a little..."
Miyasco: "Shall I give you an injection?"
Oswald: "No, that won't be necessary.
I'll just rest for a little while..."
Alforina: "Yes, you should."
Oswald: "Then, if you'll excuse me..."
Miyasco: "Will he be all right?"
Alforina: "He does tend to be rather high-strung.
He must be under considerable mental strain."
Gabon: "Hey, Miyasco. We're going into battle.
I'm going to the engine room. You head back to the bridge."
Miyasco: "Oh, Doctor!"
Alforina: "Please go.
I'm all right now."
Miyasco: "But..."
Alforina: "Besides, I'd like to get a little sleep..."
Miyasco: "...Oh! It's hard to sleep with me here, isn't it?
I understand. Then I'll take my leave without further ado."
Alforina: "Do your best."
Miyasco: "Yes. If you'll excuse me."
Alforina: "..."
Alforina: "Hmm? Miyasco?"
Oswald: "..."
Alforina: "Oh, Lord Exogilm...
Is something wrong?"
Oswald: "Your Majesty... The battle will begin shortly.
But Lord Garyud and Ciel
will probably be rescued safely."
Alforina: "...Yes, I believe so."
Oswald: "After that... We're to head for the Holy Land
as planned. I understand Matriarch Ivel
and His Highness Crown Prince Lodis are waiting there."
Alforina: "Lord Lodis is...?"
Oswald: "..."
Alforina: "A-Ahem.
I see. Very well."
Oswald: "Your Majesty..."
Alforina: "I-I don't have any particular feelings for Lord Lodis..."
Oswald: "Do you have the Resonance Crystal?"
Alforina: "Huh? The Resonance Crystal?
...Why do you ask?"
Oswald: "That thing is sealed in the Holy Land.
I thought that bringing all the keys to unsealing it together
might also look bad to the outside world."
Alforina: "That's true, but...
It'll be all right. Lord Lodis is in the Holy Land, too..."
Oswald: "!! L-Lodis again?!
At the slightest thing, Your Majesty mentions that man's name!
What do you see in a man like that?!"
Alforina: "Lord Exogilm...?"
Oswald: "I-I've watched over Your Majesty all this time...
And yet... You won't return my feelings..."
Alforina: "...What's the matter with you? You're acting strangely."
Oswald: "Strangely? Yes, perhaps I've
lost my mind. But you're partly to blame for that, too."
Alforina: "..."
Oswald: "Heh... Heh heh heh heh...
Princess, give me the crystal...
Then you'll be mine..."
Alforina: "What... are you...?"
Oswald: "Otherwise... If you don't...
Ugh! S-Stop... I... Her M-Majesty...
P-Princess... R-Run..."
Alforina: "...Are you... being controlled by someone...?"
Oswald: "Heh heh heh... P-Princess... Y-Y-You're
t-to blame... Y-Y-You won't... return...
my... f-f-f-feelings...
N-N-Now, at last... You'll be... m-mine..."
Alforina: "S-Stop it...
Ghh... Lord... Lodis..."
Oswald: "!! Y-You're still saying his name?!
That bastard! That bastard! That baaaastard!!
I won't let anyone have you! No one! No oooone!!"
Alforina: "I see... So this is the shadow... That dream...
It was you, Lord Exogilm..."
Oswald: "..."
